description: Hyderabad Police have launched SOCEYE, an AI-based social media surveillance system designed to detect and track harmful online content. The platform enables real-time monitoring, automated alerts and analysis, helping identify objectionable posts and maintain public order during sensitive incidents
body_lead: Home |Hyderabad |Hyderabad Police Launch Ai Tool Soceye To Track Online Trouble Mongers Hyderabad Police launch AI tool SOCEYE to track online trouble mongers Hyderabad Police have launched SOCEYE, an AI-based social media surveillance system designed to detect and track harmful online content.
